blocks.text: **Present Continuous** (hozirgi davomli zamon) — hozir, ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakat. O'zbekchada buni bitta fe'l qo'shimchasi bilan aytamiz: «U ishla**yapti**», «Men o'qi**yapman**», «Yomg'ir yog'**moqda**». Inglizchada esa ikki qism kerak: **be** (am / is / are) + fe'lning **-ing** shakli: She **is working**. I **am reading**. It **is raining**. Ikkalasi ham shart: **am / is / are** egani va zamonni ko'rsatadi, **-ing** esa harakat davom etayotganini.

Nega aynan shu shakl? **I'm working** degani — harakat **boshlangan**, lekin hali **tugamagan**: men uning o'rtasidaman. Avval ishlay boshladim, hozir ishlayapman, keyin ham bir oz davom etadi. **am / is / are** 1–2-darslardagi **be** fe'lining o'zi: qoidalari (I — am, bitta — is, ko'plik va you — are) o'zgarmaydi, faqat endi undan keyin sifat yoki joy emas, **-ing** shaklidagi fe'l keladi.

items.text: The children **are playing** in the yard.

blocks.text: Inkor: I'm not working, she isn't sleeping

Inkor 1-darsdagidek yasaladi: **be** dan keyin **not**. Fe'lning **-ing** shakli o'zgarmaydi. Qisqa shakllar ham o'sha: I**'m not**, he **isn't** / he**'s not**, they **aren't** / they**'re not**. O'zbekchada inkor fe'l ichida (ishla**ma**yapman), inglizchada esa alohida so'z — **not**.

items.text: Bekzod and Madina **aren't talking** to each other.

items: **Ayni gapirayotgan paytda** bo'layotgan harakat: It**'s raining**. Dad **is cooking**. Ko'pincha **now**, **right now**, **at the moment** («hozir») yoki **Look!**, **Listen!** bilan keladi;

**Hozirgi davrda** — aynan shu soniyada bo'lmasa ham — vaqtincha davom etayotgan harakat: I**'m reading** a good book at the moment (hozir qo'limda kitob bo'lmasligi mumkin). Vaqt so'zlari: **today**, **this week**, **this month**, **this year**, **these days**;
**O'zgarib borayotgan holat**: Prices **are going up**. It**'s getting** dark. — «narxlar oshib boryapti», «qorong'i tushyapti».

items.text: Right now my sister **is doing** her homework.

blocks.text: Ko'p fe'llarga **-ing** shunchaki qo'shiladi: work → working, read → reading, play → playing. Lekin fe'l oxiriga qarab yozuv biroz o'zgaradi. Bu qoidalar talaffuzni saqlash uchun kerak: masalan, «siting» deb yozilsa, u «sayting» kabi o'qilishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun undosh ikkilanadi: si**tt**ing.

rows: work → work**ing**, go → go**ing**, study → study**ing**
make → mak**ing**, write → writ**ing**, come → com**ing**, dance → danc**ing**
sit → si**tt**ing, run → ru**nn**ing, swim → swi**mm**ing, stop → sto**pp**ing, get → ge**tt**ing
lie → l**y**ing, die → d**y**ing, tie → t**y**ing
snow → snow**ing**, fix → fix**ing**, play → play**ing**

blocks.text: Ikkilanish faqat urg'uli bo'g'inda: **visit** → visi**t**ing (urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda), **open** → ope**n**ing. Ikkita unli yoki ikkita undoshdan keyin ham ikkilanmaydi: rain → raining, help → helping. Amerikancha imloda travel → traveling, lekin bizning kitob — British English: trave**ll**ing.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I working.» / «She reading.» → **I'm working.** / **She's reading.** (o'zbekchada «ishlayapman» bitta so'z, shuning uchun **am / is / are** tushib qoladi — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato); «He is work now.» → **He is working now.** (`-ing` unutiladi); «Now I read a book.» → **I'm reading a book now.** (hozirgi harakat uchun Present Simple emas); «writeing», «siting» → **writing**, **sitting**; «I'm knowing» → **I know** (bunday fe'llar — 8-dars).

Eslab qolish: Present Continuous — **ikki g'ildirakli velosiped**: biri **am / is / are**, ikkinchisi **-ing**. Bittasi bo'lmasa, gap «yurmaydi». O'zbekcha `-yapti` ni ko'rsangiz, inglizchada ikkala qismni yozing.

Bog'lanish: savol shakli (**Are** you **working**? What **is** she **doing**?) — 4-dars; Present Simple (I work) bilan farqi — 5- va 8-darslar; reja haqida gapirish (I**'m meeting** Tom tomorrow) — 25-dars; o'tgan zamondagi davomli harakat (I **was working**) — 13-dars.

rows: hozir; hozirgi davrda vaqtincha; o'zgarayotgan holat
now, at the moment, today, this week, these days

examples.title: Right now: **am / is / are** + **-ing**
examples.description: Ayni gapirayotgan paytda davom etayotgan harakat: **be** (am / is / are) + fe'l**-ing**. O'zbekchada: `-yapti`, `-moqda`.

sentences.text: **I'm cooking** dinner for the family.
Bekzod **is playing** football in the yard.
Speak quietly, the baby **is sleeping**.
**We're waiting** for the bus at the corner.
My parents **are watching** the news in the living room.
Right now Dilnoza **is talking** to her teacher.
It**'s raining**, and the streets are wet.
Sarah **is drinking** tea and **reading** a magazine.
At the moment the children **are doing** their homework.
Ouch! You**'re standing** on my foot!

examples.title: **Look!** **Listen!** — describing a scene
examples.description: Atrofda nima bo'layotganini tasvirlash: **Look!** (Qara!), **Listen!** (Eshit!) dan keyin va suratni tasvirlaganda ko'pincha Present Continuous keladi.

sentences.text: Look! It**'s snowing** in the mountains.
Listen! Somebody **is knocking** at the door.
In this photo my grandfather **is sitting** under a tree.
Two boys **are swimming** in the river.
Look at Emma — she**'s dancing** with her little brother.
A man in a red coat **is running** for the bus.
sentences.translation: Qizil paltoli bir odam avtobusga ulgurish uchun **yuguryapti**.

sentences.text: The sun **is shining**, and the birds **are singing**.
Listen — the neighbours **are having** a party again.
Everyone at the table **is laughing** at Aziz's joke.
Near the window an old woman **is feeding** the pigeons.
sentences.translation: Deraza yonida bir kampir kaptarlarga **don sepyapti**.

examples.title: Spelling: **making**, **sitting**, **lying**, **travelling**
examples.description: -ing imlosi: `-e` tushib qoladi (make → mak**ing**), qisqa unli + bitta undosh ikkilanadi (sit → si**tt**ing), `-ie` → `-y` (lie → l**y**ing), British English'da `-l` ikkilanadi (trave**ll**ing).

sentences.text: Madina **is making** a cake for her mum's birthday.
**We're sitting** in the back row.
Grandma **is lying** on the sofa — she's very tired.
Our team **is winning** two–nil!
Dad **is cutting** the bread, and I**'m putting** the plates on the table.
sentences.translation: Dadam non **kesyapti**, men esa likopchalarni stolga **qo'yyapman**.

sentences.text: Hurry up — the film **is beginning**!
James **is writing** an email to his boss.
This month Aziz **is travelling** around Europe with his friends.
sentences.translation: Bu oy Aziz do'stlari bilan Yevropa bo'ylab **sayohat qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Wait a minute — Bekzod **is tying** his shoelaces.
sentences.translation: Bir daqiqa — Bekzod oyoq kiyimining bog'ichini **bog'layapti**.

sentences.text: The weather **is getting** cold, so we**'re coming** home early.
sentences.translation: Havo **sovib boryapti**, shuning uchun uyga erta **qaytyapmiz**.

examples.title: Negative: **I'm not** / **isn't** / **aren't** + -ing
examples.description: Inkor: **be** + **not** + fe'l-ing. I**'m not** working, she **isn't** sleeping, they **aren't** listening. O'zbekchada inkor fe'l ichida: ishla**ma**yapman.

sentences.text: **I'm not watching** this film — it's boring.
Aziz **isn't working** today; he's ill.
The children **aren't listening** to the teacher.
It **isn't raining** now, but it's still cold.
sentences.translation: Hozir yomg'ir **yog'mayapti**, lekin hali ham sovuq.

sentences.text: This table is free — **we're not using** it.
My phone **isn't working**, so I'm writing from my sister's phone.
sentences.translation: Telefonim **ishlamayapti**, shuning uchun opamning telefonidan yozyapman.

sentences.text: Sarah and James **aren't speaking** to each other at the moment.
sentences.translation: Sara bilan Jeyms hozir bir-biri bilan **gaplashmayapti**.

sentences.text: You **aren't wearing** your glasses! Where are they?
Madina **isn't sleeping** — she's just lying in bed with her eyes closed.
In Tashkent the shops **aren't closing** early this week because of the holiday.
sentences.translation: Bayram sababli bu hafta Toshkentda do'konlar erta **yopilmayapti**.

examples.title: **isn't** ... — **'s** ...: what is really happening
examples.description: Inkor va tasdiq yonma-yon: nima bo'lmayotganini va aslida nima bo'layotganini aytish. He **isn't sleeping** — he**'s reading**.

sentences.text: Tom **isn't studying** — he**'s playing** computer games.
I**'m not crying**, I**'m cutting** onions!
The bus **isn't moving** — it**'s waiting** at the lights.
We **aren't living** in Tashkent now — we**'re staying** with my aunt in Fergana.
Dilnoza **isn't cooking**; her husband **is making** plov today.
My brothers **aren't fighting**, they**'re just playing**.
Bekzod **isn't sitting** at his desk. He**'s talking** to the manager.
sentences.translation: Bekzod stolida **o'tirgani yo'q**. U menejer bilan **gaplashyapti**.

sentences.text: This week the students **aren't relaxing** — they**'re preparing** for exams.
Emma **isn't wearing** a dress tonight; she**'s wearing** jeans and a jacket.
sentences.translation: Emma bugun kechqurun ko'ylak **kiymagan**, jinsi shim va kurtka **kiygan**.

sentences.text: Of course I**'m not sleeping**! I**'m listening** to every word.

examples.title: Around now: **this week**, **these days**, **at the moment**
examples.description: Present Continuous ayni shu soniyada emas, balki **hozirgi davrda** vaqtincha davom etayotgan harakat uchun ham ishlatiladi: this week, this year, these days, at the moment. O'zgarayotgan holat ham shunday: prices are going up.

sentences.text: **I'm reading** a very interesting book about Amir Temur at the moment.
sentences.translation: Hozir Amir Temur haqida juda qiziq kitob **o'qiyapman**.

sentences.text: Madina **is learning** to drive this summer.
These days my father **is working** from home.
James **is staying** at a hotel in Samarkand this week.
We**'re building** a new house near the river.
This year Bekzod **is studying** economics in London.
My sister **is looking** for a new job, but it's not easy.
sentences.translation: Opam yangi ish **qidiryapti**, lekin bu oson emas.

sentences.text: Today Tom **is helping** his parents in the garden.
Prices **are going up** fast — everything is so expensive now.
sentences.translation: Narxlar tez **oshyapti** — hozir hamma narsa juda qimmat.

sentences.text: A lot of young people in Uzbekistan **are learning** English these days.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda O'zbekistonda ko'plab yoshlar ingliz tilini **o'rganyapti**.

examples.title: Text messages: **I'm waiting** outside
examples.description: Telefon xabarlari va qo'ng'iroqlarda Present Continuous juda ko'p ishlatiladi: hozir qayerda ekaningizni va nima qilayotganingizni aytasiz.

sentences.text: **I'm waiting** for you outside the cinema.
Sorry, **I'm driving** home from work.
**We're having** lunch in a café near the station.
The train **is going** very slowly today, so I'm late.
sentences.translation: Bugun poyezd juda sekin **ketyapti**, shuning uchun kechikyapman.

sentences.text: Mum, **I'm sitting** in the library with Dilnoza.
Aziz **is coming** to the airport now — he's in a taxi.
Good news: the doctor **is checking** Grandpa now, and he**'s feeling** better.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi xabar: shifokor hozir bobomni **ko'ryapti**, o'zini ancha yaxshi **his qilyapti**.

sentences.text: It**'s snowing** heavily here in Oxford — everything is white!
sentences.translation: Bu yerda, Oksfordda, qalin qor **yog'yapti** — hamma yer oppoq!

sentences.text: Sarah and I **are walking** along the river. It's a beautiful evening.
sentences.translation: Sara ikkalamiz daryo bo'yida **sayr qilyapmiz**. Ajoyib oqshom.

sentences.text: Quick message: **I'm not answering** the phone because I'm in a meeting.
sentences.translation: Qisqa xabar: majlisdaman, shuning uchun telefonga **javob bermayapman**.

examples.title: Mixed: a busy Saturday morning at home
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: tasdiq, inkor, -ing imlosi va «hozirgi davr» ma'nosi bitta vaziyatda — shanba kuni ertalab uyda.

sentences.text: It's Saturday morning, and everybody **is doing** something.
Grandma **is making** breakfast in the kitchen.
Dad **isn't working** today; he**'s fixing** the car in the garage.
My little brother **is still lying** in bed.
In the garden Mum **is planting** tomatoes and cucumbers.
The cat **is sleeping** in the sun on the balcony.
My sisters **aren't helping** anybody — they**'re chatting** on their phones.
And me? **I'm sitting** by the window and **writing** this story.
Outside, the neighbours' children **are running** and **shouting**.
This month Grandpa **is staying** with us, so the house is very busy.
sentences.translation: Bu oy bobom biznikida **turibdi**, shuning uchun uy juda gavjum.
